readme.markdown:
# Remember Me Replication Server

Replication server for the Bible memorization app Remember Me

## Getting started

* Check out [the docs][docs].

## Configuration

The server requires the following environment variables for deployment:

* `WEB_APP_BASE_URL` - Base URL of the frontend web application
  * Used for password reset links, activation emails, and redirects
  * Format: Full URL with protocol (http or https)
  * Allowed domains: `localhost`, `*.local`, `*.remem.me`
  * Examples: `https://web.remem.me`, `http://localhost:3000`
  * Default: `https://web.remem.me`

For a complete list of configuration options, see `CLAUDE.md`.

## MCP Server

The project includes an [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) server that exposes Remember Me
to AI agents. It runs as two instances:

**Public** (`mcp.remem.me`, no sign-in) — read-only access to the published library:

- **browse_collections** — Search and filter published collections by keyword, language, or popularity
- **get_collection_detail** — Get full collection with all verse text, references, and topics
- **get_collection_metrics** — Community engagement stats (progress, mastery, activity)

**Authenticated** (`auth.remem.me`, OAuth sign-in) — the public tools plus your own workspace:

- **list_accounts / list_verses / get_verse / search_verses** — find your accounts, lists and verses
- **add_verse / update_verse / delete_verse** — manage your personal verses
- **create_collection / update_collection / delete_collection** — manage collections you publish
- **get_daily_reading** — the day's readings from a one-year Bible plan
- **get_review_queue** — your New/Due/Known boxes for a hands-free spoken review. It mirrors the
  app's flashcard run — the same box vocabulary in your language, the same
  remembered/forgotten verdicts, the same quiz direction per box — so a spoken session and the
  screen agree. The session is transient: **nothing is written back and no due date changes.**

### Local development

```bash
python manage.py run_mcp           # public server  → 127.0.0.1:8001
python manage.py run_mcp --auth    # authenticated  → 127.0.0.1:8002
```

Streamable HTTP transport, served at `/mcp`.

### Production deployment (Alwaysdata)

Each MCP instance runs as its own Alwaysdata site — its own `uvicorn` process — alongside
the main Django app, which is served via WSGI (`rm_replication/wsgi.py`). The Django app has no
ASGI entrypoint; uvicorn/ASGI is used only by the MCP servers.

1. In the Alwaysdata admin panel, create a site per instance:
   - **Type**: User program
   - **Command**: `cd ~/rm_replication && venv/bin/python manage.py run_mcp --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --settings=rm_replication.settings.prod`
     (add `--auth` and use port 8002 for the authenticated instance)
   - **Domain**: `mcp.remem.me` (public) / `auth.remem.me` (authenticated)

2. Add each site's ID to the `post-receive` hook so it restarts on deploy. Tool descriptions are
   registered once at process startup, so a restart is required for tool changes to reach clients.

toolsPreview.name: browse_collections
toolsPreview.description:
Browse published Bible verse collections. Search by keyword, filter by language, sort by popularity.

Each result includes the collection's raw cover `image` — the URL the publisher
set, or null if they set none (the app may still show an auto-generated cover when
null). This is the stored value, not the computed display image.

Args:
    search: Search term to filter by name, description, or publisher name.
    language: Language code prefix (e.g. "en", "de", "ja", "zh").
    ordering: Sort order: -downloads (default), -created, name.
    limit: Number of results (1-100, default 20).
    offset: Starting position for pagination.

toolsPreview.name: get_collection_detail
toolsPreview.description:
Get full details of a published collection including all verse text, references, and topics.

The collection and each verse include a raw `image` — the URL stored by the
publisher, or null if none was set (the app may still display an auto-generated
cover when null). These are the stored values, not the computed display image, and
round-trip with create_collection / add_verse if you copy this collection.

Args:
    collection_id: The collection ID (from browse_collections results).

toolsPreview.name: get_collection_metrics
toolsPreview.description:
Get community engagement metrics: memorization progress, verse mastery, difficult verses, and activity stats.

Args:
    collection_id: The collection ID (from browse_collections results).
